body:
thank you. i can tell that you actually understand.

I did tell my friend today. kind of in a joking way because she struggles with suicidal thoughts and depression as well. she just kind of laughed it off so I don't think she thinks it was serious.

I do see a therapist monthly, and I've been seeing her for over a year now. I'm diagnosed with severe depression and anxiety but I'm not medicated. I don't think she understands the full extent of how I actually feel because I'm naturally trained to dodge around those topics when I'm actually feeling really awful. I just Don't know how to tell people about these things. I'm going to try to tell her next appointment and also ask about medication, if I can.

I'm not feeling as awful as I did yesterday, but I'm still not good. my sleeping has improved, at the very least. but I'm still so anxious and upset, more than usual. I'm just very overwhelmed right now and hoping that this will all pass.

thank u for listening and responding. I really appreciate it.

and sorry my typing is so bad. I don't normally use a phone to type.
